Hi  
I am both a Super Host and traveller, so my places are designed for absolute comfort with discerning travellers like myself in mind!

As a long standing Australian Super host, I strive to offer fabulous, unique, sparkling clean accommodation in the vibrant Sydney suburb of Newtown just 3km from the CBD, walk to Sydney Uni and RPA Hospital.  I have been offering accommodation for 17 years, before Air BnB I was listed on more commercial sites.

My point of difference is I have a ABN and my business is run to a professional standard with correct insurances etc. There are no common shared spaces. You are not squeezing into someone else home! My places are your home away from home.

Having returned from travelling, 3 times to Santa Barbara in 2018, and in 2017  (kayaking in Antarctica and exploring Chile) and having worked in Geneva and NYC, I strive to offer guests what I need myself, a very comfortable bed, quality linen, quiet but interesting environment and a place to eat and work (a real table and chairs!), a couch, outdoor space and Wifi!

Much of my time is spent travelling  and hosting and I also have my own Clinical and teaching mental health practice so I am busy!

Here's my hosting story:

In 2000 I purpose built Studio Q as a stand alone Studio in my garden in O'Connor, a sought after leafy inner suburb with cafes a easy 10 min walk away.  The City is 3km away and ANU a 15 min walk.  This property has been sold but Simon is now hosting Studio Q.

In Newton (Sydney) I have 3 fantastic apartments in the same complex with a roof top garden.  3 mins to the train and on "the strip" of restaurants, cafes, bookshops, movie and live theatres.  Please read more under Newtown Mews listings.

You will find my favourite local tips in each unit (i.e. best local cafes, great walks and the best the area has to offer).  I am a non intrusive host, and available by phone or email between 9-7pm,  I do not offer a 24 hr Concerige service but reviews conclude I am helpful and available in reasonable hours.

O bairro tem tudo para a comodidade do hóspede: bancos academias, teatro, cinema, casa de espetáculos, lojas de rua e Shopping Center. Leider auch sehr negativ ist, dass man wirklich jedes Geräusch der Nebenzimmer hört und die Dämmung des Zimmers auch nicht besonders gut ist, sodass es nachts sehr kalt wird und die Handtücher durch anstauende Feuchtigkeit nicht trockneten.

Das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis insgesamt ist okay, jedoch war die fehlende Kommunikationsmöglichkeit ein absolutes no-go. Des Weiteren würden Kleinigkeiten (wie Kleiderhaken, zwei Stühle statt einem am Tisch...) den Aufenthalt deutlich angenehmer gestalten. Wir würden das Zimmer nur eingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.

The host and hostess thought of every details down to tooth brushes, dental floss and disposable slippers just like a hotel!  The best of all is their genuine hospitality and warmth.  We couldn’t have asked for better hosts!

Lexter & Maya waited for our arrival and greeted us at entrance to the building which is important as it is along a very busy walkway and can easily be missed.  The building entrance may look old but the apartment is renovated, well equipped and sparkling clean.  The hosts brought us up by lift and ensured we are settled in the apartment.  All our queries throughout our stay were answered promptly,  including where to buy certain things, and they even helped to call a taxi for our early morning flight out of HK.  The pocket wifi and local mobile phone were a big help for us.  The apartment is cosy for 4 adults, we managed with 1 big luggage & 2 smaller ones.  It has all the amenities of a hotel, what's better than a hotel are the 6kg washing machine, lots of hangers to hang laundry, big fridge, microwave and a hot water dispenser.  After a whole day outside, you can come back in the evening to do your laundry, they will dry the next day inside the apartment.  
The apartment's location is perfect - walking distance to many famous eateries (eg Kam Wah, Hong lin, Tsui Wah, Hang Heong, roast goose/meat stalls),  Mongkok MTR just minutes away (Prince Edward/YMT stations are walkable as well), shopping areas (Ladies Market, Gold fish market, Langham Place etc).  There are many local sundry shops and fresh market downstairs to buy local dried seafood, herbs, chinese sausages,  fresh fruits even fresh meat if you want to cook; and a shop selling hot steamed rice with meat, variety of dim sum, dumplings, buns is right downstairs operating from 6am till night time.   No need to venture out of the area to find food or get all your shopping done really, we only used the MTR to go for sightseeings beyond Mongkok.
A good experience overall, highly recommended.
